name: v0.11.1
body:
To install or update `git-branchless`, run the following:

```console
$ cargo install --locked git-branchless
$ git branchless init  # in your repository
```

## Release highlights

*None.* This is a fixup release that includes no new features or changes in behavior.

### Changed

- (#1672): `scm-bisect` has been updated (was missed in v0.11.0)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/arxanas/git-branchless/compare/v0.11.0...v0.11.1

If you're interested in contributing, check out the Developer Guide in the [Wiki](https://github.com/arxanas/git-branchless/wiki), or post in the [Discussions](https://github.com/arxanas/git-branchless/discussions) or [Discord server](https://discord.gg/caYQBJ82A4) to ask any questions.
